name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal window that is a sheet of paper dropped on the desk: it lands with a small tilt that settles, the page behind goes dim under a lamp, and the close button is a doodled x. Tape it, pin it, tear its edge; on a phone it becomes a sheet at the bottom of the screen.

a11y: Reka UI Dialog: role=dialog with `aria-labelledby` (the title) and `aria-describedby` (the description); give every dialog both. Focus moves into the sheet, Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside it, Escape closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.
The page behind is inert while the dialog is open (pointer events off, aria-hidden on siblings) and scroll is locked.
The close button is a real button named "Close"; the x is decorative ink. In Windows high contrast the ink hides and a plain × takes its place.
The drop-in, the fade and the hover blot follow `--ll-motion`: with reduced motion the dialog simply appears. In `calm` density the sheet is flat, untilted and untaped.
Portalled content repeats the InkProvider's `data-density`, `data-motion` and `data-theme`, so density and reduced motion work inside the dialog too.

`modal={false}` works as in Reka UI: no dim (the sheet sits in a frame that lets clicks through), the page stays interactive and scroll is not locked. Clicking a Sonner toast never counts as "outside", so a toast action pressed over a dialog does not dismiss it. On a phone the bottom sheet pads its foot by `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`, and the dim reserves its scrollbar gutter so the drop-in cannot make a classic scrollbar shove the sheet sideways.
meta.usage:
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import {
  Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline">Edit profile</Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent tape="both" class="sm:max-w-[425px]">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Edit profile</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {/* form fields */}
        <DialogFooter>
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
          </DialogClose>
          <Button type="submit">Save changes</Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}
